annotations.title: Turn payment route off or on

description: Deactivate a payment route so it stops accepting new deposits, or reactivate it. You can reactivate only a route your organization deactivated (deactivation_reason TENANT_REQUEST); a route Stables deactivated can only be reactivated by Stables support. Reactivating may charge the current month's account fee from the prefund balance if it has not been paid.

status.description: 'deactivated' to switch the route off, 'activated' to switch it back on
